name: The Saturnians
summary: Saturnians are moth wizards. For many generations, they have passed down techniques for making "light weaving" wands. They yearn to explore the unknown and meet new species. Saturnian villages are usually built on floating islands. When Saturnians ally with each other they typically connect these cities together into a larger network. Most Saturnians are from the largest network of cities, the country Solalei.
